# Functions that remove rows of a list table (subscriptions, hoppers,
# hopper_items, reading, items, versions, shelf) without naming the prune
# decision (`api::Prune`, `Store::lists_prune`), and why each may
# (tests/it/list_prune_scan.rs). A removal driven by a list the blyg served
# doesn't belong here: it takes or reads the decision instead.
#
#   <path under crates/> <function> | <reason>
#
blyg-core/src/store/mod.rs delete_item | your removal: a draft deleted here, or a post whose delete the blyg just confirmed
blyg-core/src/store/mod.rs put_versions | not a list's word: rewrites one item's version rows from that item's own copy as the blyg returned it (a push's answer, a fetch of that item)
blyg-core/src/store/reading.rs drop_subscription_rows | your removal: the rows of a subscription unsubscribed here
blyg-core/src/store/hoppers.rs set_hopper_member | your removal: a post taken out of a hopper here
blyg-core/src/store/hoppers.rs remove_hopper | not a list's word: a hopper deleted here, or one the blyg answered 404 for by id (`LiveBackend::delete_hopper`, `update_hopper_again`)
blyg-core/src/store/shelf.rs set_on_shelf | your removal: a post of yours taken off Saved here
blyg-core/src/store/shelf.rs set_entry_on_shelf | your removal: a post taken off Saved here
blyg-core/src/store/shelf.rs apply_shelf | guarded by its caller, not here: `Engine::sync_shelf` (`sync/shelf.rs`) lays a newer contract's shelf through `show_shelf_union`, which passes the union so nothing comes off
